out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed cases of water stored on the store room floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Discontinue storing foods on the floor. Store all foods at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: A case of cups was stored on the floor in the storeroom.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip or irreversible temperature thermometer available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Obtain heat sensitive strips or an irreversible temperature thermometer as soon as possible. The PIC ordered a new unit during the inspection to correct. CDI.
